settings.heading: The feature you need doesn't have to wait for a roadmap.
settings.prompts:
Create a multi-currency checkout with local payments for Uruguay and Argentina…
Build a loyalty wallet that issues points on every order and redeems at cart…
Generate an agent that recovers abandoned carts with personalized offers…
Add a last-mile logistics board with carrier routing per market…
settings.body_1: Transform ideas into production-ready commerce capabilities using natural language. GOnama generates the code, builds the interface, validates the solution, and prepares it for deployment.
settings.body_2: Developers, agencies, IT teams, and business owners can ship checkouts, dashboards, integrations, AI agents, workflows, or entire modules — without starting from scratch.
settings.footer: From prompt to production, in hours instead of weeks.

settings.title: Code of Conduct
settings.body:
We act with integrity in every market we operate. Respect, fairness and accountability guide how we work with customers, partners and each other.

We commit to: honest communication, zero tolerance for discrimination or harassment, and responsible use of company and customer data.

settings.title: Data & Privacy
settings.body: Commerce infrastructure handles sensitive operational and customer data. We design systems with privacy by default and comply with applicable regional regulations.

settings.title: Security
settings.body: Security is a product requirement, not an afterthought. Access controls, encryption, and continuous review protect the platforms we operate.

settings.title: Responsible AI
settings.body: AI agents and automation must remain aligned with human intent, transparent where it matters, and safe in production commerce flows.

settings.heading: Discover Our Leadership Principles
settings.lead: Our principles define who we are — our identity, our mindset and the way we build the future of commerce. They guide how we make decisions, solve problems and create value.
settings.culture_body: At GOnama, we believe the future of commerce will be built by combining technology, artificial intelligence and exceptional people.
